## PR digest completeness + decided items: the triediff-comment workflow now… — 2026-07-25 (parent 91b4e8de1036)

The triediff-comment workflow now enumerates every digest file a PR added (via the PR files API), iterating oldest-first and skipping already-commented files, so multi-commit PRs surface all digests rather than only the newest. A shared `_install_managed_workflow` engine (create/updated/unchanged/skipped/error) was extracted and reused by both the existing triediff installer and the new sync-bot installer.

New symbols:
- `render_sync_bot_workflow` — emits a fork-guarded, budget-capped CI workflow that runs `trie sync` with the org API key and pushes the result
- `install_sync_bot_workflow` — installs it under the same ownership contract as the triediff workflow
- `setup_cmd` gains `--with-sync-bot` flag, reports the install outcome, and reminds about `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
- `Sync.retry_total_seconds` default changed from 0 to 300 (bounded-by-default; 0 still opts out)
